_evidence: Keyword string addressed by +4 of a 0x0052b2c0 table entry and compared by 0x52b2db with the text at esi until its NUL ('mov edi,[edx+4]; call 0x52b2db'): bytes 0..6 from {a,b,c,NUL} (empty, short and long keywords that match or fail against a text drawn from the same letters), byte 7 NUL so every keyword ends inside its 8-byte buffer as a real string does.
